shortTitle: AASM RLS and PLMD Treatment Guideline
citation: Winkelman JW, Berkowski JA, DelRosso LM, et al. Treatment of restless legs syndrome and periodic limb movement disorder: an American Academy of Sleep Medicine clinical practice guideline. J Clin Sleep Med. 2025;21(1):137-152.
driveFileName: 2025 - AASM Guideline for RLS and PLMD Treatment - Winkelman et al.pdf
currencyNote: This 2025 guideline explicitly updates the 2012 AASM practice parameter and reflects the current AASM treatment recommendations for RLS and PLMD when verified 2026-08-07.
bestFor: Current treatment framework for restless legs syndrome and periodic limb movement disorder in adults and pediatric patients, including treatment classes, iron-status context, augmentation awareness, and distinctions between RLS and PLMD treatment questions.

mappingRationale.D1A: Supports current disorder/treatment context for RLS and PLMD during clinical assessment and disorder recognition. It is not a PSG scoring-rule source.

authorityBoundary: Use ICSD-3-TR for diagnostic classification and the current AASM Scoring Manual for PLMS scoring rules. This guideline controls treatment guidance, not event scoring or diagnostic criteria.
copyrightUse: Use citation, public headings, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial recommendation wording, evidence tables, or protected passages.

sections.label: Good-practice treatment context and contributing factors
